solver.automation_path: external ANSYS Maxwell or COMSOL solve followed by deterministic CSV import

winding.coil_shape: explicit trapezoidal sector coils uniformly placed at 30 mechanical degree pitch

boundary_conditions.outer_boundary: magnetic insulation on the outer cylindrical and axial air-domain boundaries
boundary_conditions.periodic_symmetry: none in v1; solve the complete 360 mechanical degree machine
boundary_conditions.motion_method: moving-band or rotating-domain transient/position sweep chosen by external 3D solver
boundary_conditions.phase_current_condition: open-circuit no-load; zero imposed phase current
boundary_conditions.magnetization_definition: alternating axial magnetization with source-defined Br and recoil permeability

mesh_plan.acceptance_rule: every coarse-to-medium and medium-to-fine change in tracked back-EMF and flux linkage must be <= 1.0 percent

output.waveform_period: one electrical period corresponding to 72 mechanical degrees at five pole pairs
output.endpoint_policy: sample the start and exclude the duplicate end point for numerical waveform analysis
output.extraction_notes: export source-native flux linkage and voltage samples; total RMS and fundamental RMS are computed numerically after import

provenance.parameter_origin: all values intentionally fixed by Phase 7H before any field-solver output exists
notes: This is a synthetic controlled machine, not a published or experimental motor.
The coreless topology avoids an untraceable steel B-H curve in the first reference.
The 12-slot/10-pole A+,C-,B+,A-,C+,B- repeated layout and its analytical projection winding factor are frozen before FEA; the field solver uses explicit coil domains rather than kw.
No FEA result exists until an independent solver executes all three mesh levels and passes convergence.
